findings.text: The page that changed was never shot. All 16 page folders under shots/ are old task pages (e.g. shots/…2026-10-02-panel2-sessions/sheet.png). The diff only added a hidden `{"file":"shots/","gone":true}` line to those pages. `/framework/ai/sessions/` has no shot at any width, so none of the red tags, the mastermind tag, the chip headings or the fixed-height in-flight strip has visual proof (requirements: "smoke-test the page at 1400 wide").

Duplicate chips come back under new keys (req 3). The new role `vscode tab` and the old fallback `vscode mastermind` both label as "VS Code tabs". The new `terminal` and the old `cli` both label as "Terminal sessions". Any row with no session-flags.json entry (a missing or stale file, or a transcript outside ~/.claude/projects) falls back to the old key, so two chips with the same label appear (AISessionRows.js ROLE_LABELS + role_of).

`session-flags.json` is committed: a 7,897-row generated file, one huge line in the diff. The readme line says it is "gitignored", but `git check-ignore` finds no rule. It will churn on every watcher run. Add the ignore rule and drop the file from the commit (move it aside, not destroy it).

The diff carries about 190 unrelated data files: ~389 `{"file":"shots/","gone":true}` lines across old `files.jsonl`/`page.jsonl` files, plus two health-watch 404 cards in board.jsonl. This churn is what made review.mjs shoot 16 wrong pages. Leave it out of this task's merge.

Red flags depend on a hand-started `node Server/session-flags.mjs --watch` ("keep the watcher running"). If it is not running, the file goes stale: stalled stops flagging (the `fresh_ms` gate) and roles freeze. Nothing in Servex starts or supervises it. The page also re-fetches the file every 30 s (setInterval + fetch), which goes against "stream, don't poll".

Expensive uses lifetime cost over $10 across ~7.9k sessions. "needs attention · N" will likely count many long-finished sessions, which hides the live ones. That is the owner's literal threshold, but consider counting only open or recent sessions.
Mis-indented lines and a whitespace-only line in AISessionsPage.js (render_flight sort, the check() block around `needs attention`).
Widths given: 400, 1200, 1920, 3440, but only for the unrelated pages. The sessions page was not shot, so every layout answer below is `not measured` for the changed page.
